note: Parts outside the joint library, each with an exact expected size and volume worked out by hand. Used to measure whether AI-written CadQuery code is actually right, not just whether it passes the tool's own gates.

items.text: a flat washer, 20 mm inner diameter, 40 mm outer diameter, 3 mm thick
a rectangular plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm with four 8 mm through holes, each hole centre 10 mm from both edges at each corner
a cylinder 50 mm diameter and 80 mm long with a 20 mm diameter through hole along its axis
a hexagonal bar 24 mm across flats and 50 mm long
a solid shaft 40 mm diameter and 200 mm long with a flat-bottomed keyway 12 mm wide, 5 mm deep and 60 mm long, square-ended, starting at one end
